name: Smoke Screen
description:
Passive Ability
Hides your position during the preparation phase.

Battlecry Ability: Activates before the battle starts
Immediately throws a smoke bomb. If there are enemy chess pieces nearby, the smoke bomb will be thrown at the position of the Riki; otherwise, it will be thrown at the symmetrical center point of the board relative to Riki. Enemies within the smoke are silenced and blinded(attacks have a chance to miss)
